BepiColombo Probe Reaches Mercury Orbit After Eight-Year Journey

The BepiColombo probe has successfully entered Mercury's orbit, marking the first visitor to the planet in over a decade. The mission, a joint effort by the European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, embarked on its eight-year, 6-billion-mile journey to reach Mercury.
